components.name: Primary Action Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--btn-primary-bg, #1c1915); color: var(--btn-primary-fg, #faf7f2); border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--btn-primary-hover, #332e27); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-coral, #e76f51); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Route Strategy Switch
components.description: Segmented Express (Coral) vs. Deep Mastery (Jade) strategy selector.
components.css: .ds-strategy-well { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-recessed, #f2ece1); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e4ddd0); max-width: 280px; } .ds-tab-express { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; padding: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: #e76f51; color: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-idle { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; padding: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-secondary, #595147); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab-idle:hover { color: var(--ink-primary, #1c1915); } .ds-tab-meta { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-top: 2px; opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Topic Input Field
components.description: Top-bar curriculum topic input with warm focus border.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Generate a prerequisite graph for any subject..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; max-width: 360px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cfc5b4); background: var(--bg-ground, #faf7f2); color: var(--ink-primary, #1c1915); padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-muted, #857b6e); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; background: var(--bg-surface, #ffffff); border-color: var(--accent-coral, #e76f51); }

components.name: Preset Topic Chip
components.description: Quick subject chip inside the top curriculum bar.
components.css: .ds-chip { border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e4ddd0); background: var(--bg-recessed, #f2ece1); color: var(--ink-primary, #1c1915); padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #cfc5b4); }

narrative.overview:
Paretoium is an Operate-mode academic workbench designed to feel like a calm, tactile drafting desk rather than a generic SaaS dashboard. Every surface is built from warm mineral paper and espresso ink in light mode, inverting cleanly to deep warm charcoal and ivory in dark mode, while reserving saturated color strictly for route semantics and graph state.

The interface prioritizes scannability, hierarchical clarity, and zero visual noise. Prerequisite graphs use top-down Dagre hierarchy with orthogonal stepped connectors and compact flat course tiles so complex multi-track curricula read at a glance without floating drop-shadow clutter.
keyCharacteristics: Warm alabaster and sandstone neutral hierarchy paired with deep espresso ink (#1c1915).
Strict two-route color encoding: Terracotta Coral for Express (Min Hours) and Veridian Jade for Deep Mastery (Max Coverage & Depth).
Flat-by-default surfaces separated by 1px hairline stone borders (#e4ddd0), reserving shadows only for floating overlays.
Native system sans-serif paired with tabular monospace (tabular-nums) for course codes, hours, and Pareto trade-off metrics.
Full Light and Dark mode parity driven by CSS custom properties (:root and html.dark).

rules.name: The Semantic Route Rule
rules.body: Terracotta Coral always means Express (Min Hours) and Veridian Jade always means Deep Mastery or Completed. Never use either color for unrelated decorative chrome.

rules.name: The Paired-Ink Rule
rules.body: Because mid-tone accents (#e76f51, #36ba98, #e9c46a) can fall below 4.5:1 as small text on white, always pair small labels with their -ink token on their -soft tint, or use dark espresso text on filled Jade/Saffron pills.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every numeric counter (hours, difficulty sum, coverage percentage, quiz score) uses tabular-nums so dragging constraint sliders never causes layout jitter.

rules.name: The Flat-Tile Rule
rules.body: Graph course nodes carry zero drop shadows at rest; active route membership is communicated by a 1.5px Terracotta or Jade border, and non-path nodes step back to 50% opacity.

dos: Do use CSS custom properties (var(--bg-surface), var(--ink-primary), var(--border-subtle)) on all new UI elements so Light and Dark modes stay synchronized.
Do preserve pathMode (express vs. deep_mastery) when users adjust constraint sliders.
Do keep Hierarchy ↓ (TB Dagre + smoothstep orthogonal edges) as the default graph layout.
Do provide keyboard escape hatches (Esc to close inspector/drawers, Alt+Click to toggle completion).
donts: Don't introduce cold Tailwind slate/indigo/teal classes or neon cyan gradients.
Don't add drop shadows, floating overlapping pills, or one-sided accent bars to CourseNode tiles.
Don't place small white text on #e9c46a (Saffron) or #f4a261 (Apricot)—use dark espresso ink (#1c1915) instead.
Don't wrap study-guide sections in generic 01 / 02 / 03 marketing cards.
